data.desc: Laser Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ:LASE) is an emerging laser technology company focused on developing directed-energy weapons for defense applications as well as industrial laser technologies to modernize domestic manufacturing infrastructure supporting the U.S. military and national security. The Company develops laser platforms for four principal markets: defense, semiconductor, pharmaceutical and industrial. Through internal development, strategic acquisitions and partnerships, LASE intends to expand its technology portfolio, strengthen its advanced manufacturing capabilities, scale the enterprise profitably and build shareholder value.
